dedupe_keys.name: nmc 622 battery responses to particle size porosity and discharge rate

description: The NMC 622 deposit publishes numerical battery-response data for changes in particle size, porosity and discharging rate. The producer identifies the results as design-parameter calculations for a nickel-rich cathode lithium-ion cell, and Mendeley lists two Excel workbooks. The linked article describes a finite-element COMSOL calculation with an NMC 622 cathode and lithium-metal anode. Access to the data is free under CC BY 4.0. Geographic coverage and a calendar observation period are not applicable to these simulated cell configurations; file-level resolution and variable units were not checked. The workbooks should not be treated as independent experimental validation, and no reusable COMSOL model archive was verified. A reviewer-assessed use is testing parameter sensitivities or reduced electrochemical surrogate models for storage-system simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam offers related project-level battery modelling, but equivalence of equations or automatic workbook import was not established.
